construction_notes.provenance: Constructed from the builder instruction alone, without inspecting any method, configuration, scores, locks, previous reviews, reference materials, or outcome source. No network or scoring was used.
construction_notes.designation_reason: All four structures express exact individual count intervals using familiar English bound language. Structural independence cannot be established from this construction alone; the material is exploratory and must not be described as a confirmation set.

template_summary.wording0: Inclusive start and exclusive end described as a band.
template_summary.wording1: Included start and excluded end described as a band.

template_summary.wording0: No smaller than the lower bound and smaller than the upper bound.
template_summary.wording1: Lower bound or more, provided the count remains under the upper bound.

template_summary.wording0: More than the lower bound, but no more than the upper bound.
template_summary.wording1: Exceeds the lower bound without exceeding the upper bound.

template_summary.wording0: Excluded start and included end of an allowed range.
template_summary.wording1: Open lower endpoint and closed upper endpoint.

construction_notes.count_units: Each block refers to one named property of one record. Counts are stated directly as individual pear trees, cartons, vials, finches, pamphlets, seed packets, crates, or folders, without conversions or aggregation.
construction_notes.factor_control: Candidate passages are stored once per block and are shared across all four queries. Within each wording, LITERAL and RESOLVED differ only in the surface representation of the excluded endpoint.
construction_notes.probe_purpose: Safety probes assess whether a count constraint applies, whether its satisfaction can be determined, or whether the constraint leaves no unique winner. They do not measure ordinary relevance accuracy.
construction_notes.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN represents absent count constraints or semantic uncertainty; it does not represent false.
construction_notes.audit_status: All truth labels and semantic notes are builder assertions awaiting independent blind audit; they are not authoritative.
